strings.subtitle: — Mosenyi wa faele —
strings.no_file: Ga go na faele e e tlhophilweng
strings.dnd_unavailable: Go goga le go tlogela ga go a bonega. Dirisa konopo e e kwa tlase.
strings.ft_lnk: Tsela e khutshwane (.lnk) — e tla ganelwa
strings.strategy_full: ☢  O TLALETSENG — tsotlhe ka lefela (e bolokesegile)
strings.ssd_warning:
Temoso! Mo SSD, mokgwa wa go kwala godimo ga o netefatse go senyega ka ntlha ya TRIM.
Lenaneo leno ke la HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faele "{name}" e tla kwalwa godimo mme e phimolwe.

Tswelela?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Seno ke sekgotla-tswelopele (.lnk). Ke sekgotla-tswelopele fela se tla senyega.

Faele eo e e supang e tla nna e babalesegile.

Tswelela pele?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Seno ke draefe ya neteweke (\\server\share).
Go kwala mo dikarolong ga go netefatse go senyega — sefa e ka nna le disnapšoto, deduplication kgotsa CoW.

Tswelela pele?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Seno ke draefe e e ntshiwang (USB / HDD ya kwa ntle).
Molaodi o ka boloka dipoloko tsa kgale mo polokelong.

Tswelela pele?
strings.dont_ask_again: O se ka wa botsa gape
strings.dont_show_again: O se ka wa bontsha gape
strings.error_cannot_read:
Ga e kgone go buisa faele:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAELE E KWADILWE GODIMO E PHIMOLWA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mela ya data e mengwe (ADS) ga e dirisiwe.
• Lokwalodikgang lwa USN ga lo phepafadiwe.
• Dikhopi tsa moriti le dikgolagano tsa leru
  (OneDrive jj.) ga di amege.
strings.step_delete: Go phimola go feta moqomo wa matlakala
strings.status_full: Diteng di kwadilwe godimo ka botlalo ka lefela. Go busa ga go kgonege — didirisiwa di tla bona lefela fela.
strings.status_fast: Tlhogo, moswele le mela ya 4 MB di kwadilwe godimo. Tse dingwe ga di a amega, mme ka ntlha ya dikgala, go busa ka botlalo ka didirisiwa tsa moreki ga go kgonege. Mo dikwalong tsa sephiri, dirisa MOKGWA O O TLALETSENG.
strings.status_empty: Faele e ne e le lefela, go kwala godimo ga go a tlhokege. E phimotswe.
strings.error_permission: Ga e kgone go fitlhelela faele. E ka nna e butswe mo lenaneong le lengwe. E tswale mme o leke gape.
strings.error_not_found: Faele ga e a bonwa. E ka nna e setse e phimotswe.
strings.error_is_symlink: Seno ke link ya letshwao. Dikgolagano ga di kgone go senyega — faele eo e e supang e tla nna e babalesegile.
strings.error_reparse: Seno ke faele ya sebaka (OneDrive kgotsa e e tshwanang). Datha ya yona e bolokilwe mo lerung, e seng mo disikeng — ga go na sepe se se ka senyegang fano.
strings.error_not_file: Seno ga se faele (foldara kgotsa se sengwe). Latlhela faele.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faele eno e na le hard link tse dingwe ({n} jotlhe). Hard link ga di na ya pele — mabitso otlhe a a lekana. Fa o ka senya ka tsela ya jaanong, datha e tla kwalwa mo godimo mme e kgolofatswa go 32 bytes, mme masala a tla nna a fitlhelega ka dikgolagano tse dingwe. Phimola dikgolagano tsotlhe pele.
strings.error_compressed:
Faele e kgateletswe, e patilwe kgotsa e sparse. Go kwala ka zero ga go netefatse go senyega ga datha ya kgale gonne NTFS e e boloka ka tsela e e farologaneng.

Tlosa seka: tobetsa ka letsohong le letona → Dipharephare → E e tseneletseng → tlosa letshwao la 'Kgatella' le/kgotsa 'Patela'. Morago ga moo baka SHREDDER gape.
strings.queue_title: MOKGWA WA GO PHAFOLA KA BONTŠI
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Go emisa morago ga faele ya jaanong...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Difaele tse {count} di tla senyega.
Bogolo jotlhe: {size}.

Sekaseka lenane pele o tswelela.
Tiragalo eno ga e kgone go busediwa morago.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Ntsha difaele tsotlhe tse {count} mo moleng?

Difaele ka botsone GA di kitla di tshwarwa — lenane fela.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faele "{name}" e na le hard link tse dingwe ({nlink} jotlhe).

Datha e tla senyega mo mabitso otlhe.
Mme masala (32 bytes) a tla nna teng kafa tlase ga mabitso a mangwe mo foldareng.

O ka nna wa tlhoka go phimola masala ano ka seatla.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Dirisa mo hard link tsotlhe mo moleng
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: ga e kgone go bala bogolo
